scope: Evidence enrichment for the next bounded base-game/PQ61-PQ70 skill tranche
policy: Promote only fields directly supported by current Xenoverse 2-specific skill references and independent quest documentation. Do not infer reward-slot probability or Ultimate-Finish requirements from mere PQ association.

records.name: Fighting Pose H
records.evidence: Existing repository research identifies PQ61 as the acquisition route and current skill-specific documentation identifies the move as a temporary defensive Power Up Super using 0 Ki. The reviewed current source set supports the maintained 20-second duration semantics.

records.name: Teleporting Vanishing Ball
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies PQ62 as the unlock route, 300 Ki cost, teleporting projectile behavior, 15-hit structure, and knockback. Independent Dragon Ball documentation corroborates the PQ62 acquisition and Kid Buu association.
unsupported_or_unresolved: exact damage percentage as canonical combat data

records.name: Ill Rain
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies Ill Rain as a 100 Ki Ki Blast Super obtained from PQ64; the move launches an aerial projectile that splits into three smaller projectiles. Independent Dragon Ball documentation corroborates the PQ64 acquisition.
unsupported_or_unresolved: exact damage percentage as canonical combat data

records.name: Scissors Paper Rock
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies PQ65 as the unlock route, 100 Ki cost, three selectable inputs, three-stage/three-hit structure, short-range behavior, and knockback. Independent community discussion corroborates that it is a quest reward rather than a character-kill-only drop, while not establishing a probability.

records.name: Super God Fist
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 skill documentation identifies PQ67 as the unlock route, 100 Ki cost, fast single-hit Strike behavior, and grab-like properties. The same source documents its use as a fast combo/conversion tool.

records.name: Angry Shout
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies PQ68 as the unlock route, 300 Stamina cost, Strike Evasive classification, area knockback/damage, and Ki restoration.

records.name: Headshot
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies PQ69 as the unlock route, 300 Stamina cost, Strike Evasive classification, single-hit close-range behavior, and knockback.
unsupported_or_unresolved: exact damage percentage as canonical combat data

records.name: Emperor's Blast
records.evidence: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies PQ70 as the unlock route, 100 Ki cost, rear-facing single-hit Ki Blast behavior, and a three-second stun on successful hit.
unsupported_or_unresolved: exact damage percentage as canonical combat data

next: When the supported canonical skill builder/runtime is available, fold these evidence-backed fields through the normal research-to-canonical/index path and validate downstream acquisition projections. Until then, do not manually reconstruct the oversized canonical catalog.
